name_reason: Compliant with convention: data_fd2_<domain=resource>_<descriptor=last_loaded_resource_size>. Descriptor accurately reflects a scalar holding the byte size of the most recently loaded DAT resource (a size/counter datum). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix); the only numeric meaning here is the resource domain, not an address. The 'resource' token appears in both domain and descriptor (mild redundancy) but the name is clear, correct, and a rename would churn globals.h plus all call sites for no semantic gain.
purpose: Caches the byte size of the most recently loaded DAT archive resource, computed by fd2_load_dat_resource on every load so callers (and the loader itself) know the buffer length without tracking it separately.
logic_summary: Single 32-bit BSS scalar (zero-init). Written once in fd2_load_dat_resource @ 0x1123c as end-start, i.e. header[1]-header[0] from the archive's 8-byte [start,end] offset pair (disasm: MOV EDI,[EBX]; MOV EAX,[EBX+4]; SUB EAX,EDI; MOV [0x53BFF],EAX). Immediately consumed in the same call as the malloc size @ 0x1124a and the fread byte-count @ 0x11285. Also read by fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @ 0x25a07 as the size argument to fd2_dpmi_lock_size(buf, size) to DPMI-lock the just-loaded FDMUS sequence. Always written before any read, so the zero initializer is never relied upon at runtime.
element_semantics: Non-negative resource byte-count (size of last-loaded DAT resource payload). Accessed only as a full 32-bit dword everywhere; declared uint32 to match the access width and its use as a malloc/fread/lock size.
notes: Plate at 0x53BFF was empty in Ghidra; created a concise PLATE_COMMENT per src conclusion (data plate via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)). src/rsrc/rsrc.c comment block (lines 847-868) already precise/accurate/ASCII and matches disassembly; left unchanged, so no edit to rsrc.c. xrefs: WRITE @0x1123c, READ @0x1124a/@0x11285 (both in fd2_load_dat_resource), READ @0x25a07 (fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade). Game writer present -> non-const.
